comments.text: I have made Cacio y Pepe. The secret to it is to save some of the noodle water when adding the cheese because the noodle water helps bind the cheese to the pasta. Such a simple dish but so tasty! All you need is the pasta, black pepper, pecorino Romano cheese and water.

comments.author: @scotth2313
comments.text: Chongqing noodles are my absolute favorite noodles since I stayed with my daughter and son-in-law in Rongchang during lunar new year in 2024. There was a little noodle house within a few minutes walk from their place. I never would’ve thought of noodles for breakfast before that. The woman at the noodle house also did some tailoring work and repaired to rip in my jeans for the equivalent of a quarter. From that first day, I always liked it when we were going someplace in the morning because that meant stopping at the noodle house before we went on our way.
